notes:
Account snapshot: Tritonix KBServe — midsize SaaS provider powering knowledge-base driven support for fintech customers. Primary product: hosted KB + bot for 100+ enterprise customers.

Context / ask:
- Wants hosted API for inference (no private infra initially). High QPS at peak business hours (target sustained 1.5k-2.5k qps).
- Indexing: ~8M documents (mix short help articles, long KB pages, attachments). Incremental updates every 6 hours.
- Embeddings: prefer 1536/2048 dims, currently evaluating cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Reranking: exact need = hybrid retrieval (HNSW) + cross-encoder rerank top-100 for precision SLA on NPS-critical flows.
- Latency targets: p50 < 40ms for vector lookup + model embedding; end-to-end p95 < 200ms for simple Q/A, p95 < 350ms when cross-encoder rerank triggered.
- Cost target: marginal inference cost target <= $0.003/query averaged across traffic (embeds + rerank amortized). Highly cost sensitive.
- Reliability: need graceful fallback to cheaper model variant when capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for keys. Data residency not strict today but may require EU region for specific customers.

Notes from latest calls:
- 2025-02-03 discovery call w/ Ava + Diego + CTO (R. Singh). "We need consistent p95 under load — any excursions cost us SLA credits to customers."
- Asked for hosted API QPS ramp plan and cost model for two scenarios: (A) full cross-encoder rerank for top-100, (B) hybrid: dot-product rerank + lightweight re-rank for top-10.
- Provided sample queries (1.1k rows) and gold labels. Want to run quality evals (MRR, Recall@10) after POC.

Technical preferences / constraints:
- Vector store: open to managed (Milvus) or Redwood-backed vector routing. Currently prototyping with FAISS on-prem internally.
- Batching: prefer continuous small batching to keep latency low; want Redwood Optimize suggestions for batch sizing and prefix cache.
- Embedding frequency: precompute nightly + incremental re-embed pipeline for updates.
- Rerank budget: limit CPU/GPU rerank to 10% of queries during peak. Need autoscaling policy for burst + fallback.

POC plan (agreed):
1) Redwood to provision hosted API test endpoint with 3 model variants (embed-only cheap, embed+light rerank, embed+cross-encoder heavy).
2) Tritonix will run 14-day traffic replay (sanitized) up to 2k QPS with step-ramp.
3) Redwood to deliver per-query cost breakdown, latency percentiles, and quality metrics (MRR/Recall) for each variant.
4) Joint go/no-go meeting and procurement ask.

Next steps for AE:
- Deliver cost/latency projection + sample SLA wording by 2025-02-25.
- Legal to send DPA template; follow up with Tritonix legal (in progress).
- SE to onboard sanitized dataset and kick off traffic replay.

Other CRM tidbits:
- Quote from CTO: "If we can keep costs under $0.003/q and p95 under 300ms, we can standardize on Redwood for all KB tiers."
- Prefer short, empirical reports. Likes diagrams > long text.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization + async rerank cache.

Stated blockers:
- Need sanitized dataset (PII removal) — Tritonix engineering SLA 1 week.
- Procurement paperwork (commercial) not started — legal review blocking sign-off.

"Chatter" items (sales shorthand):
- cost-sensitive, technically savvy buyer, cross-encoder appetite but will fall back if cost too high.
- strong focus on p95 reliability under sustained high QPS.
